title: The Extra Cushion at the Window
youtube_title: The Extra Cushion at the Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Tamsin sees that an extra cushion wide enough for two will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Tamsin makes a smaller, even share so Pilar is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
